Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap + proposed success criteria and next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of scope (as discussed):
- Primary use case: customer support triage + intent extraction for inbound email.
- Secondary: knowledge-base retrieval for short-form answer generation (FAQ flow).

Proposed success criteria (quantitative where possible):
- Intent classification: >= 88% macro F1 on sample labeled set (500 emails).
- KB retrieval + answer quality: 85% of answers rated "useful" by Acme SMEs on a 5-point scale (sample of 200 queries).
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 350 ms for typical 256-token requests in Dedicated environment.

Timeline & ownership:
- Data deliverables from Acme (sample emails + KB export): due June 25 (Elena).
- Redwood setup & baseline run: Jun 26–30 (Camila).
- Joint evaluation & scoring: Jul 1–9 (Marissa / Priyom / Acme SMEs).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or flag changes by end of day Monday (Jun 22).
2) Elena, share the data export link and a list of 3 SME reviewers.
3) I'll share the POC SOW and rebaseline plan for sign-off once we have final criteria.

Attachment: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Overall this looks good, a couple of asks from our side before the SOW is finalized: 

1) We want to add a third use case to the trial: automated invoice routing (classify incoming invoices to the correct internal queue and extract vendor + amount). This is lower complexity but high business impact for us. Can Redwood take a look at adding this into the POC?

2) On the timeline: if we add invoice routing, can we keep the evaluation window Jul 1–9 or will we need extra time? If an extension is needed, what is the minimum extra time required?

Marissa / Priyom —

Quick engineering feasibility check for adding invoice routing as a scoped use case:

- Work required: ingest PDF samples, run OCR pipeline, add a lightweight extraction schema (vendor, amount, invoice_date), and a classification head for queue routing. We can reuse the same Dedicated endpoint + cache for inference.
- Data prep: Acme needs to supply unredacted PDFs (or OCR text) + mapping CSV.
- Time: engineering + infra work ~ 4 business days to integrate and run baseline. Evaluation-wise, we should add a 1-week buffer to the joint scoring window to allow SME review of extraction accuracy.
- Risk: OCR variability on scanned PDFs may reduce extraction recall — recommend sample-driven thresholds in the SOW.

Recommendation: Accept the invoice routing add-on but rebaseline the evaluation window to Jul 1–16 (adds 7 days). Owners: Camila to run integration, Priyom to coordinate the data ingestion and baseline metrics, Marissa to handle SOW sign-off / procurement.

If you want, I can draft a short rebaseline plan and updated success criteria to share with Acme.

—Camila
